name: stm32u0
description: Building for the STMicroelectronics STM32U0: the CMSIS core headers, the device headers, the startup assembly, and the HAL driver.

dependencies.name: stm32u0-cmsis-core
dependencies._why: The ARM core headers. In the Cube repository itself, not the device repository, which is why the Cube repository is in this set at all.

dependencies.name: stm32u0-cmsis-device
dependencies._why: The device header, plus the startup assembly and the system file. The startup is what gives a bare-metal program a vector table and an entry point; a preset without it produces a program that cannot be started.

dependencies.name: stm32u0-hal
dependencies._why: The HAL driver. Which of its files a build compiles is the board's decision, not this preset's: they are named per board.
